title: Reduce allocations in the "Export to Execl" scenario
summary: The Export to Excel scenario now allocates less memory by reusing objects instead of creating new ones for each cell, reducing garbage collection pressure in production.
key_points: Reuse CellDecorator object instead of creating a new one per column
Avoid allocating ExcelBuf record for cell format name calculations
Eliminate method scope allocations by inlining AL method call
Reduces allocations from 168GB to 68GB for 100k G/L Entries export
Cuts garbage collection pause time from 12.8 seconds to 5.7 seconds
quote: removes three easy allocations that was done for each column of each row
